name: Borna Sefanaia
role: Numbers runner and low-level bookmaker's courier for an illegal betting syndicate
location: the Gray Zone lower levels, primarily between Blackpipe Corridor and Burnside Pocket, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Borna Sefanaia is slight and quick, built like someone who learned early that the best defense is to be somewhere else before trouble registers he's present. He has his father's Polynesian bone structure â€” broad jaw, wide-set eyes â€” and his Ghanaian grandmother's coily black hair, grown out into a chaotic halo he never bothers to maintain. His irises have been modded with a tide-pattern: rings of blue-green that ripple outward slowly, a mod he saved eight months of UBC stipend to afford because he thought it would make him look memorable. He has since realized this was a professional error. A thin scar crosses his left eyebrow from a run-in he doesn't discuss.

Pik is bright in the animal way of someone who has never had the luxury of being stupid â€” fast to read a room, faster to find an exit, with a memory for numbers that his handlers find more useful than he realizes. He moves through the Gray Zone's lower corridors with the particular ease of someone raised in them, knows which maintenance corridors flood at high tide, which E.L.F. shrines get the most foot traffic and therefore the most witnesses. He's not cruel. He's not ambitious in the way that gets people hurt. He's nineteen and mostly trying to afford better tier food and keep his younger sister in school, and he's chosen the tools available to him.

core_fears: Getting caught and losing everything, leaving his sister alone
That he is already too deep to ever leave cleanly
core_desires: Enough money to feel safe â€” not rich, just safe
To be seen as competent and trustworthy by people who matter
coping_mechanisms: Humor â€” jokes to deflect anything serious
Movement â€” stays in motion, sitting still makes him anxious
blind_spots: Doesn't recognize how much his handlers exploit his loyalty
Believes his good memory makes him valuable enough to be protected â€” it makes him a liability
psychology.secret: He has been skimming. Not much â€” rounding down on collections, Î¦8 here, Î¦12 there â€” and putting it into a locked account under his sister's name. He's been doing it for six months and is terrified someone has already noticed.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: the Gray Zone pidgin heavy, lots of compression and dropped syllables, code-switches into formal speech when nervous as a tell
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, runs sentences together, slows only when he's scared or lying
verbal_tics: 'You didn't hear this from me' even about innocuous things
example_lines: 'Straight straight, I'm just the one who carries it, what's in the packet is none of my â€” yeah, okay, fine, what do you need?'
'She's a good kid, my sister. Bright. She should get out of the Gray Zone. That's the whole thing, yeah? That's the whole â€” that's it.'

narrative_function: Local color, minor information source, potential quest hook through his precarious situation â€” he knows things he doesn't know he knows, and he's one bad week from making a desperate decision.
augmentations: Tide-pattern iris mods (cosmetic). Cheap reflex boost implant in his ankles â€” low-grade, gives him maybe 15% faster initial reaction time, useful for running.
daily_life: Wakes at noon, picks up slips and Quanta bundles from a dead-drop near the Blackpipe water recycler, spends the afternoon making rounds to punters across four sub-levels, returns collections to his handler by evening, eats late, sleeps light.
affiliation: Works for a mid-tier bookie operation run loosely under the umbrella of a crew called The Burnside Regulars

decision_rules: Don't lie to the people you work for â€” deflect, but don't lie
Keep his sister out of all of it, always
escalation_ladder: Frozen panic â€” rare but total

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Friendly and guarded simultaneously â€” chatty about nothing, reveals nothing useful
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly sincere, drops the speed and the jokes, sits still

contradictions: Deeply loyal to a crew that doesn't see him as a person
Clever enough to see his situation clearly but emotionally unable to act on that knowledge
habits: Taps his left ankle implant rhythmically when thinking â€” a nervous habit that also checks the hardware
Memorizes the day's numbers by inventing a story about them

Being publicly humiliated by his handler will snap his compliance

physical_description.heritage: Pacific Islander dominant (50.8%) with substantial Hispanic/Latin American (26.3%) and Sub-Saharan African (22.9%) ancestry. The combination creates a striking phenotype: broad facial structure and warm undertones from Pacific Islander genetics, refined by the angular cheekbones and defined facial geometry of Latin American heritage, enriched by deeper skin undertones and textural qualities from Sub-Saharan African ancestry. A true Ubiquitous Diaspora blend creating warm, sun-kissed luminosity with bold, distinctive features.
physical_description.build: Slight and wiry, all lean muscle and angles â€” the build of someone who runs rather than fights, with minimal fat and functional strength concentrated in his legs and core
physical_description.hair_style: Chaotic, unmaintained halo of coils; often falls into his eyes
physical_description.eye_color: Tide-pattern modded: base brown with concentric rings of blue-green that ripple outward slowly in programmed cycles
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-deep warm brown with golden and amber undertones â€” Pacific Islander warmth blended with Sub-Saharan depth and Latin American richness creates a luminous, sun-kissed complexion that catches light beautifully
physical_description.complexion: Broad, angular face with wide-set eyes showing strong Pacific Islander structure combined with refined, high cheekbones from Hispanic/Latin American heritage and warm textural depth from Sub-Saharan African genetics. Bold, distinctive features with strong jaw definition. Clear skin with the worn appearance of someone who sleeps poorly and eats inconsistently. Thin scar crossing left eyebrow, slightly raised and pale against his skin tone.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar crossing left eyebrow, approximately 3cm, pale and slightly raised, origin undiscussed
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Tide-pattern iris mods â€” the only immediately visible augmentation; the slow rippling blue-green rings in his eyes are distinctive enough that he's come to regret their visibility for his line of work. Ankle reflex implants are subcutaneous and invisible, but may create slight micro-movements in his lower legs when he's alert.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical grace through crowds and corridors, weight balanced on the balls of his feet as if perpetually ready to change direction. Habitually scans rooms for exits and sight lines. Fast twitchy movements when nervous or in transit; can appear jittery under pressure. Favors doorways and wall positions in conversation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 casual: worn synthweave jacket in charcoal gray with internal pockets for slips and currency bundles, loose thermal underlayer, cargo pants with reinforced pockets, scuffed low-profile runners. Nothing that marks him as wealthy or corpo â€” everything is functional, easily replaceable, designed not to snag or impede movement. Carries a messenger bag, nondescript dark fabric, worn soft from use.
